### `logic.src.utils.actions.__init__`

Unified tensor actions/operations for combinatorial optimization.

### `logic.src.utils.actions.distance`

Distance and Tour Length Operations.

- `get_distance()` — Compute Euclidean distance between two batched coordinate tensors.
- `get_distance_matrix()` — Compute pairwise Euclidean distance matrix from coordinates.
- `get_tour_length()` — Compute total tour length for a batch of ordered location sequences.
- `get_open_tour_length()` — Compute total tour length for open tours (no return to start).

### `logic.src.utils.actions.graph`

Graph Operations (Sparsification, Edge Indices).

- `sparsify_graph()` — Create a k-nearest-neighbor sparse graph from a cost/distance matrix.
- `get_full_graph_edge_index()` — Get edge index for a complete graph (cached).

### `logic.src.utils.actions.pomo`

POMO (Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima) Operations.

- `select_start_nodes()` — Select start nodes for POMO-style multi-start decoding.
- `select_start_nodes_by_distance()` — Select start nodes based on distance from depot.
- `get_num_starts()` — Get environment-specific number of start nodes for multi-start decoding.
- `get_best_actions()` — Select best actions from multi-start rollouts.

### `logic.src.utils.actions.probabilistic`

Probabilistic Operations (Entropy, etc).

- `calculate_entropy()` — Calculate entropy from log probabilities.
